description: Get a short news briefing on a topic where each point cites its numbered source. Send a topic and receive a sourced news briefing in one call: fresh headlines are collected, then summarised into a structured JSON brief with a summary, key points each citing its numbered source, and the open questions the headlines do not settle. The raw headlines come back alongside the brief, so an agent can verify every claim or follow a link. Replaces the two calls agents make today, a news search followed by a summarisation prompt, and costs less than assembling them by hand. — $0.050000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "summarize today's headlines on x", "brief me on the news about x", "sourced news summary".
name: brief
